UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Personal profile and personal display/card/block visibility preferences for a signed-in user (Admin or Servant).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name in Arabic or English.

groupId.description: ID of the currently active group the user is viewing, or empty string if unassigned.

joinedGroupIds.description: Optional bounded list of group IDs this user is a member of for switching between groups.

enabledCards.description: List of enabled card type IDs for this servant's main screen view.

collapsedBlockIds.description: Personal list of block IDs collapsed on this user's screen only.

hiddenBlockIds.description: Personal list of block IDs hidden on this user's screen only.

compactViewMode.description: Personal display mode preference for this user only.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Group.title: Group
Group.description: A Sunday school class group managed by one Admin (الأمين) and up to 6 Servants (خدام).

inviteCode.description: Unique uppercase alphanumeric group code matching the document ID.

adminId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Admin (الأمين) who owns the group.

adminName.description: Display name of the group Admin.

memberUids.description: Bounded list (max 10) of member UIDs (Admin + up to 6 Servants).

allowServantUndo.description: Whether a servant is allowed to undo/delete a card event they recorded by mistake.

enforceWeeklyCardLimit.description: Whether the same card can only be awarded once per child per week.

maxMonthlyPoints.description: Optional maximum monthly points cap per child (0 = unlimited).

attendanceIsCardOnly.description: Whether attendance is tracked exclusively via the 3-point Attendance card.

showLeaderboard.description: Whether to display the monthly points leaderboard.

autoStudentNumber.description: Whether student numbers are assigned sequentially and automatically.

bannedUids.description: Optional bounded list of UIDs of servants removed and banned from rejoining this group.

bannedServantEntries.description: Optional bounded list of 'uid|name' strings for banned servants displayed to the Admin.

dailyInviteToken.description: Optional 24-hour rotating suffix paired with inviteCode (<inviteCode>-<dailyInviteToken>).

inviteCodeUpdatedAtMillis.description: Optional epoch milliseconds when dailyInviteToken was last generated/rotated (valid for 24 hours).

Invitation.title: Invitation
Invitation.description: An invitation issued by the Admin for a Servant to join the group.

adminId.description: UID of the Admin who created the invitation.

inviteeName.description: Name or label of the invited servant.

acceptedByUid.description: UID of the servant who accepted or responded to the invitation.

memberUids.description: Optional bounded list of group member UIDs.

ServantBlock.title: ServantBlock
ServantBlock.description: A shared colored block in the group assigned to a Servant.

servantId.description: UID of the responsible servant (or empty if unassigned placeholder).

servantName.description: Display name of the responsible servant.

colorHex.description: Theme color key or hex code for the block.

memberUids.description: Optional bounded list of group member UIDs.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: A shared child record in the group with fractional position ordering.

studentNumber.description: Sequential or custom number of the child.

blockId.description: Assigned ServantBlock ID, or empty string for 'بدون بلوك'.

sortOrder.description: Legacy integer ordering position inside the block.

position.description: Shared fractional position inside the block so concurrent moves never overwrite each other.

avatarInitials.description: Arabic/English initials displayed on the child's badge.

avatarBase64.description: Optional compressed 1:1 square JPEG thumbnail stored as Base64 (<= 50,000 chars).

createdByUid.description: UID of the group member who added the student.

memberUids.description: Optional bounded list of group member UIDs.

CardEvent.title: CardEvent
CardEvent.description: Shared audit log entry for awarding one of the 7 cards to a child in the group.

studentName.description: Target student name for audit display.

cardType.description: One of the 7 approved card types.

servantId.description: UID of the servant who tapped the card.

servantName.description: Name of the servant who tapped the card.

memberUids.description: Optional bounded list of group member UIDs.

MonthlyBalance.title: MonthlyBalance
MonthlyBalance.description: Shared monthly points balance summary for a child in a specific YYYY-MM month.

totalPoints.description: Total points accumulated in this month.

eventsCount.description: Total cards awarded in this month.

lastUpdatedByUid.description: UID of the member who last updated the balance.

memberUids.description: Optional bounded list of group member UIDs.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user profile and personal card/block visibility preferences.

/groups/{groupId}.description: Sunday school class group document keyed by inviteCode.

/groups/{groupId}/invitations/{invitatio.description: Group invitations created by the Admin.

/groups/{groupId}/blocks/{blockId}.description: Shared colored servant blocks within a group.

/groups/{groupId}/students/{studentId}.description: Shared children records assigned to blocks or unassigned within a group.

/groups/{groupId}/cardEvents/{eventId}.description: Shared idempotent card award events for children in the group.

/groups/{groupId}/monthlyBalances/{balan.description: Shared per-month points balance summaries per student.
